reason: Both identify the identical off-by-one mechanism: hasMoreIntervals checks payload.page <= MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES (24) against the current page before incrementing, so when page 24 returns activities, 24 <= 24 is true and page 25 gets queued/fetched — one page beyond the documented/intended cap of 24. Same location, same root cause, same consequence (extra page fetched, ~2 months of extra history walked). The reviewer additionally notes the loop is still bounded and suggests the `<` fix, but that's elaboration, not a different defect.
